89343: An ex-convict, recently released from prison, who seeks out apprenticeship under the legendary Eighth Generation Yakumo Yuurakutei after witnessing his rakugo performance. He is taken in as Yakumo's first ever student, and is given the name Yotarou (rakugo slang for "fool").
89345: A legendary rakugo performer who is haunted by his past. He refused to take in any apprentices until he met Yotarou. As a child, Bon had originally trained as a dancer until damage to his leg left him unable to dance.
89346: Shin was the Eighth Generation Yakumo's lifelong friend and partner growing up, and Konatsu's father. Apprenticed under Yakumo Yuurakutei alongside Bon, he was originally given the name "Hatsutarou," but rejected it to instead perform under the name "Sukeroku.
89577: A mysterious woman who originally worked as a geisha, thanks to Yakumo the 7th's help. She normally supports Kikuhiko by giving him encouragement and watching his rakugo performances.
89707: Konatsu is the daughter of Sukeroku and Miyokichi, and Yakumo the 8th's ward. She normally fights back against what Yakumo says and wants, and will exhibit this sort of behaviour to anyone else she doesn't trust. She is also a great teacher of rakugo, although somewhat stern.
255021: This man was Yotaro's direct superior in the yakuza. He is also the underling of the Oyabun. At the beginning of the series, he tries to convince Yotaro to rejoin the yakuza, but is convinced that Yotaro is better off performing rakugo after witnessing a moving performance.
255022: This man is the head of the yakuza gang that Yotaro was once a part of. He likes to listen to Yakumo-sensei's rakugo.
369125: The Seventh Generation Yakumo Yuurakutei and master of Bon and Shin. While performing rakugo in Manchuria during World War II, he meets Miyokichi and introduces her to his students.
